# Lantern Sync 3.8.0

Lantern Sync 3.8.0 makes large uploads faster and changes what happens when two devices edit the same file.

## What changed

- **Faster uploads:** Files over 1 GiB upload up to 40% faster. We did it by raising the default chunk size from 8 MiB to 16 MiB.
